description: Reproduction of signed illustration. A woman, seen from the side, wears glasses and a high-collared dress with a large bow. Text beneath the image reads "I see nothing to laugh at, I want perfect silence at once." To the right of this drawing is an image of a woman crying and looking downward, also in profile. Text overlapping the image reads "Oh! I want my boys!!"
dimensions: 6 1/8 x 8 or 8 x 6 1/8 inches, sheet, orientations vary
